documents.title: Hospital Inpatient Discharge Summary
documents.content: 68-year-old male with ischemic cardiomyopathy (LVEF 30%) admitted with 15-lb fluid weight gain, severe orthopnea, and bilateral 3+ pitting edema. Responded briskly to IV Furosemide diuresis with 6L net negative fluid balance. Discharge weight stabilized.

diagnostics.conclusion: BNP significantly elevated at 1,890 pg/mL (Ref: <100 pg/mL), confirming acute decompensated heart failure.
